profile.headline: Software Developer | Information Architect | Systems Programmer
profile.summary:
Software Developer / Architect / Systems Programmer who has produced innovative designs, robust code, and improved system efficiency and reliability. Expert in IBM z/OS assembler language, including macros and conditional assembly language.  Highly knowledgeable and extensive experience coding in MVS internals and applications.  Systems programmer for TCP/IP, VTAM, NetView and other MVS products.  Experience in web (HTML, CGI) development, and web services.  Demonstrated abilities to solve problems and implement effective solutions.

Specialties: Architecture and design, assembler language, z/OS, online systems

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Development, debugging, and maintenance on z/OS catalog management utility and infrastructure for zIIP processing.  Writing 64-bit assembler and Metal C.

positions.title: Lead Technology Architect
positions.description: Analysis and design of new applications and systems.  Mainframe assembler programming on a large online system.

positions.title: Sr. Systems Engineer
positions.description: Batch and online software development for large text databases, and web application.

positions.title: Sr. Consulting Analyst
positions.description: Batch software development for loading large text databases.

positions.title: Sr. Technical Specialist
positions.description: Installation and maintenance of vendor software products, system software development.
